articles.title: Iran claims it has lifted self-imposed restriction on ballistic missile ranges
articles.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has opted to remove the 2,000-kilometer missile range restriction amid rising tensions. A US naval blockade is affecting global trade routes, while recent airstrikes close to Yemen have resulted in the deaths of over 27 people, underscoring the ongoing strife. In response, the US Central Command has established a task force aimed at crippling Iran's transportation networks, leading to heightened anxieties about potential confrontations.
